about.text: Redefining gaming gear through innovation, precision, and passion since 2018
Born from Passion, Built for Performance

NEXUS was founded by a team of competitive gamers and engineers who believed that gaming gear should be as dedicated to performance as the players themselves. What started in a small garage in San Francisco has grown into a global brand trusted by esports athletes and casual gamers alike.

Our mission is simple: create precision-crafted peripherals that give you the competitive edge. Every product we design undergoes rigorous testing to ensure it meets the demands of professional gaming.
"Gear is an extension of the player. When it disappears in your hands, that's when magic happens." — Marcus Chen, Founder
Every component is selected for durability and performance. We test each product to exceed industry standards before it reaches your hands.
We push the boundaries of what's possible, integrating cutting-edge technology to give you the competitive advantage.
We listen to gamers, collaborate with pros, and continuously evolve our products based on real feedback from the community.
To empower gamers worldwide with precision-engineered gear that unlocks their full potential, creating unforgettable moments of victory and connection.

From the initial concept to the final product, every NEXUS device goes through a meticulous engineering process. Our team of designers, engineers, and pro gamers collaborate to refine each component for optimal performance.
We use advanced materials, proprietary switch technology, and rigorous testing protocols to ensure that every click, movement, and sound is perfectly tuned for the gaming experience.
NEXUS is founded in San Francisco with a mission to revolutionize gaming peripherals. First prototype of the Phantom keyboard is created.
Phantom Mech Keyboard launches to critical acclaim, selling out within 48 hours. NEXUS gains recognition in the gaming community.
Aether X Wireless Mouse and Spectra Headset join the lineup. NEXUS becomes official sponsor of multiple esports teams.
NEXUS products are featured in major gaming tournaments worldwide. Awarded "Best Gaming Peripherals" by TechGaming Magazine.
Commit to 100% carbon neutral operations and eco-friendly packaging. Launch of the Pro Series for competitive esports.
Serving over 1 million gamers across 50+ countries, continuing to innovate and push the boundaries of gaming technology.
Former esports competitor with a passion for engineering. Leads the vision and product strategy at NEXUS.
Industrial designer with 15 years of experience. Crafts products that are both beautiful and functional.
Electronics specialist and gamer. Ensures every product delivers peak performance and reliability.
Connects with gamers worldwide, gathers feedback, and builds the NEXUS community.
We believe that great gaming gear should be accessible, sustainable, and built to last. Every NEXUS product is designed with the environment in mind and backed by our satisfaction guarantee.

product-details.text: Experience ultimate precision with our Phantom Mech Keyboard. Features hot-swappable switches, RGB backlighting, and a durable aluminum frame. Perfect for competitive gaming and long typing sessions.

The Phantom Mech Keyboard is engineered for peak performance. With full N-key rollover and anti-ghosting technology, every keystroke registers instantly. The hot-swappable switch design allows you to customize your typing experience without soldering.
Features include: RGB per-key lighting with 16.8 million colors, programmable macros, magnetic wrist rest, and a durable braided USB-C cable. Compatible with Windows, Mac, and Linux.
Switch Type:Hot-swappable MechanicalFrame Material:Aluminum AlloyKeycaps:Double-shot PBTPolling Rate:1000HzConnectivity:USB-C WiredDimensions:14.2" x 5.1" x 1.5"Weight:2.4 lbs
